lastCompletedStory.title: Reviewer re-runs the gate at Layer B and writes the artifact-of-record

nextStoryContext: US-004 added REVIEW_ARTIFACT_FILENAME ('scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt') constant and artifactOfRecord?: string field to ReviewReport in src/supervisor/review-report.ts. Both runtime (.claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md) and template (templates/agents/subagent-reviewer.md) reviewer agent prompts now instruct the reviewer to independently re-run the behavioral gate at Layer B (not trusting the implementer's Layer A result), write capture output to scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt as the artifact-of-record, and record the path in review-report.json via the artifactOfRecord field. Both Constraints and Exit-report clauses in both prompt copies now name both permitted write files (review-report.json AND review-artifact.txt). Both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore now include scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt. Vendor was re-embedded (src/vendor/_generated.ts). The next story can rely on REVIEW_ARTIFACT_FILENAME being the single source of truth for the artifact path.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only edited agent prompt .md files, TypeScript type/constant additions in review-report.ts, and gitignore entries. No external library was exercised.
